run_download_d4rl_datasets: run the script to download all 16 D4RL gym datasets and pickle them as episode paths
run_download_single_d4rl_dataset: run the script to download a single D4RL dataset like halfcheetah-medium-v2 and save it as a pickle file
refactor_download_d4rl_datasets_to_funct: refactor the script to wrap the dataset download loop into a reusable function with env and dataset type parameters
refactor_download_d4rl_datasets_argparse: refactor the script to add argparse support for selecting specific environments and dataset types to download
summarize_download_d4rl_datasets: summarize the script that downloads D4RL offline RL datasets, parses trajectories into episodes, and saves pickle files
